review_comments.body: **Identity test misses broken rewrites** The identity fixture gives the source and partition field the same name, so this test passes even if rewriting under `NOT` stops working. The unchanged predicate already qualifies as a partition filter, and `pushed` only counts filters. Add a case with different field names and assert that the returned expression uses the partition field name.
